Recorded claim:
`commands/graph/worktrees.mjs` creates paired Gecko/comm worktrees under `~/.tb-tools/worktrees`; `commands/graph/build.mjs` uses compatible completed snapshots from `~/.tb-tools/build-cache` and reconfigures each private object directory. Fresh artifact worktrees run a complete `mach build` once, then `mach build faster`; run `mach` from the Gecko root. [Task 2]
